excelRendering: LibreOffice explicitly selected. Excel-only derived image permits internal charts with SC CJK open-font substitutions; macro execution, OLE automation, external-link blocking and the LO sandbox remain enabled. Cached worksheet formula values are frozen for print, without recalculation. Preflight rejects OLE, macros and external image/data relationships.
isolation: One disposable container per task, internal network, no public ports or host document mounts; shared bounded Office queue.
promotionPolicy: Excel is disabled by default in the API and production frontend. Verify fonts, licenses, exact image and outputs on the target host before enabling. Never replace the approved Word image pin.
